# Dividend Calculator

> Free dividend calculators: dividend yield, dividend growth, DRIP reinvestment,
> monthly dividend income and payout ratio.

Dividend Calculator is a free, ad-supported educational tool suite for income
investors. Every calculator runs client-side in the browser; there is no
sign-up and no data collection. Estimates only — not financial advice.

## Calculators
- [Dividend Yield Calculator](https://www.dividendpayoutcalculator.com/calculators/dividend-yield-calculator): annual dividend per share ÷ share price
- [Dividend Growth Calculator](https://www.dividendpayoutcalculator.com/calculators/dividend-growth-calculator): project future dividends with a compound growth rate
- [DRIP Calculator](https://www.dividendpayoutcalculator.com/calculators/drip-calculator): simulate dividend reinvestment compounding
- [Monthly Dividend Income Calculator](https://www.dividendpayoutcalculator.com/calculators/monthly-dividend-calculator): monthly passive income from a portfolio
- [Dividend Payout Ratio Calculator](https://www.dividendpayoutcalculator.com/calculators/dividend-payout-ratio-calculator): dividends ÷ earnings, sustainability check
